name: seed-unresolved-e2e-fixture-form
body: The e2e is DB-fixture-based rather than a scratch-repo CLI scan because unresolved target FQNs are emitted unrooted (foreign names) and inserted verbatim by the ingestor, so they can never equal a rooted real Function or Struct FQN (zero matches in the current graph); upgrade to a real-CLI assertion only if the ingestor starts canonicalising Unresolved targets.
